title: Find All Numbers Disappeared in an Array

content.problemStatement:
You're given an array `nums` of length `n` where every value is in the
range `[1, n]`. Some values appear twice and others don't appear at all.

**Return a list of all the numbers in `[1, n]` that are missing from the array, in ascending order.**
constraints: array length is n, every value is in range [1, n]
some values may appear twice, some may be missing entirely
return missing numbers in ascending order
content.inputFormat: Single line: JSON array of all arguments, e.g. [arg1, arg2, ...]

sampleTestCases.explanation: n = 8, and 5 and 6 never appear in the array
every number from 1 to 3 is present, nothing is missing

hints: Can sorting the array simplify the problem, or does sorting take too long compared to a hash table lookup?
Consider two-pointer approaches if the array is sorted, or a sliding window if looking for contiguous subarrays.
Prefix sums or prefix XORs can answer range sum queries in O(1) time after O(N) preprocessing.
